labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter's non-terminal output is intended Rich behaviour (control codes stripped when piped); reporter also confirmed it was their setup.

body:
Rich strips control codes when its output is not a terminal, such as when it is piped through `tee`, so the bar does not update in place. Running the script directly in a terminal is the expected way to see the progress bar update. If you need the control codes in a regular file, set `force_terminal=True` on the `Console`: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/console.rst

For usage questions, see [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
